title: runs/<run-id>/artifacts/data/authorization-report.yaml
description: What happens to the authorization decision and package after R-4 (R-5): receipt, retention, availability, marking and verification of the terms. AUTHRPT-001 judges it.

decision_ref.title: Ledger record this report is about

received_by.title: System owner or common control provider who received the authorization decision and package

received.title: Date the authorization decision and package were received

terms_acknowledged.title: The receiver acknowledges the terms and conditions of the authorization

retained_by.title: System owner or common control provider who retains the authorization decision and package

policy.title: Record retention policy the authorization decision information is retained under

retain_until.title: Date until which the authorization decision information is retained

available_to.title: Organizational officials to whom authorization documents are available when requested

operational_awareness.title: Operational commanders verified to hold the system's cyber risk information, and the coordination on each risk that affects an operational requirement

informed.title: Officials the authorizing official verified to have the necessary cyber risk information on the system

affected_requirements.title: Operational requirements a cybersecurity risk affects; empty when no risk does

risk.title: Risk of the risk assessment report that affects the requirement

coordinated_with.title: Officials the authorizing official facilitated coordination with

marking.title: Marking of the authorization package contents, whose sensitive information is marked and protected

verified_by.title: Authorizing official who verifies the terms and conditions are followed

frequency_days.title: How often, in days, the terms and conditions are verified

assessment_records.title: Assessment records retained for the audit trail, reuse and repeatability

source.description: Trace token: an interview answer (INT-007.A3), an assumption (ASM-012, ASM-BASELINE-001), a product file with optional anchor (product/architecture.md#identity) or an artifact (ART-SSP).
